tyler: Heads-up: were doing the route_windowed_metrics reorg next Tue 03:00 UTC. Goal: replace metrics_agg v1 with new partitioned schema to support horizon windows + cheaper p99 aggregations. Runbook: https://wiki/redwood/runbooks/route-windowed-reorg
jess: Whos owning dashboard compatibility? We have lots of Grafana panels directly selecting from metrics_agg.
tyler: @matt will handle dashboard patches. We'll add a compatibility view `metrics_agg_v1_view` that maps old column names for 48h, but patching must happen before we flip read flag.
sam: Whats the canary plan and parity criteria?
tyler: Canary traffic: 2% for 10m -> 10% for 20m -> 100% if parity OK. Parity checks: row_count by route (within 0.4%), p50/p95 latency deltas, and quota tokens used. Parity job emits a CSV and a small JSON summary to s3 and posts here.
rachel: Important: new schema uses `window_start` + `window_len_ms` and deprecates `bucket_ts`. Quota service depends on bucket_ts for sliding windows; we need a thin adapter in quota-service to interpret new fields. Add feature flag `quota::use_windowed_metrics`.
matt: Dashboard patch strategy: 1) replace table refs to `metrics_agg` -> `metrics_agg_v1_view` via API 2) for templated queries referencing `bucket_ts`, translate to `window_start`. I'll run dry-run on staging dashboards and produce a list of panels needing manual edits.
dbops: Backfill estimate: naive full-table copy ~22h and will saturate IO. Recommend day-by-day windowed backfills with checksums. We'll run 7 parallel workers limited to 15% io cap. Backfill SQL example:
```sql
INSERT INTO route_windowed_metrics (route_id, window_start, window_len_ms, metric_name, value)
SELECT route_id, floor_extract(ts, '5m') AS window_start, 300000 AS window_len_ms, name, sum(value)
FROM metrics_agg GROUP BY route_id, window_start, name;
```
sam: Read-adapter toggle: router needs header `X-READ-METRICS=agg1|agg2` with default `agg1` until we promote. Rollback command: `POST /flags/route_windowed_read -d '{"value":"agg1"}'`
jess: Alerts: existing quota burn alerts reference `metrics_agg.quota_used`. We'll create a new series `route_windowed.quota_used` and keep both alerts firing until 48h post-cutover. Example alert rule snippet:
```yaml
- alert: RouteQuotaSpike
  expr: increase(route_windowed.quota_used[5m]) / increase(route_windowed.quota_alloc[5m]) > 0.85
  for: 5m
```
tyler: Shadow-write status from deploy-bot: 99.9% success over last 48h, schema mismatch errors = 0. Good to go on writes.
matt: Patch checklist: run dry-run patcher, export list, manual fix for panels with complex SQL (joins). Ill post PR with migration mapping.
rachel: Quota-service: plan is to gate new calc behind flag and run both calcs in parallel for 24h to compare outputs. If diff > 0.5% for top-100, abort. We need a sidecar that logs calc diffs to s3.
dbops: We'll also create a read-only `metrics_agg_legacy_snapshot` for a week to support ad-hoc queries. Important: snapshot uses MVCC safe export to avoid long locks.
sam: Oncall coverage? I can take 02:30-06:00 UTC. @jess will cover morning handover. Set PD schedule accordingly.
tyler: Final cutover steps: 1) confirm day-0 backfill complete 2) enable 2% canary + parity job 3) if green -> 10% 4) patch quota flag 5) patch dashboards 6) promote to 100%. If parity fails at any stage rollback read flag and pause backfill.
matt: Dry-run staging patch done by 23:00 UTC tonight. Will post broken-panel list.
dbops: Canary parity job kicked at 3591235200 for 2% window. ETA ~8m.
deploy-bot: parity job result: all checks within thresholds; max row_count_diff = 0.21% (top routes).
jess: sweet. I'll run quota calc smoke on staging (10m) and report.
sam: I'll be online for cutover. Paging channel: #release-war-room and this thread for updates.
all: :shipit:
